descriptionByLocale.en: Place of work: Hirslanden Klinik Permanence | BernOccupation as of: June 1, 2026 or by appointment Type of employment: Permanent Reference number: 69916 As the largest medical network in Switzerland, we set standards with our clinics, outpatient surgery centers and emergency departments. The radiology department in the Institute of Radiology at the Permanence Clinic has new technologies and modern infrastructure for imaging procedures and offers you a comprehensive range of radiological diagnostic modalities. The equipment park is attractive and consists, for example, of MRI, CT, image intensifier and conventional systems. We are looking for a qualified radiology specialist (a) to join our team in the Institute of Radiology at the Permanence Clinic. SRK recognition) and have already acquired in-depth knowledge of MRI and CT cross-sectional imaging technology - You are a team-oriented, flexible and open-minded personality - Your way of working is precise, you are responsible and enjoy working independently - You enjoy working with patients and working in interdisciplinary specialist areas - Your oral and written German skills are at a very good level (min. C1) You can find an overview of our employment conditions and benefits under: Team diagnosis - What we are missing, are you. For additional information, please contact Mathias Barann, Co-Head of Radiology Hirslanden Bern, at mathias.barann@hirslanden.ch or T, and Raphael Brand, Head of Recruitment, at raphael.brand@hirslanden.ch.
